title: 第一章 斗罗大陆，异界唐三（四）
content_zh:
唐三不想失去这个父亲，也更不希望自己过往的一切被人知道，所以，他自然不会告诉唐昊，这是因为他修炼着唐门的玄玉手。
想用好暗器，最基础的需要是眼力、手力、心力的融合。正所谓心到眼到，眼到手到。所以，在唐门内门的修炼方法中，对于眼力、手力的要求极高。
紫极魔瞳，借助旭日东升时紫气东来的短暂时刻进行修炼，对眼力有着极大的提高作用。
玄玉手，可以令手掌变得极其坚韧，并且隔绝任何毒素。
这两种能力，是唐门内门弟子的必修课。尽管唐三的玄玉手还远远不够火候，但保护自己手掌不被磨出水泡还是能做到的。
“再加把劲，今天就能完成了。”唐三卖力的挥动着手中的铁锤，在这枯燥的过程中，他的心却并不平静。对于这个世界，他的了解还很初步，毕竟，这里只是个小村子而已。
这个世界叫斗罗大陆，在大陆上有两大帝国，或者也可以说成是两个联盟。因为在两大帝国之中，大量的领土分封诸侯，拥有武装力量的贵族多不胜数。
这两个帝国一个是唐三所在的天斗帝国，另一个，则是南方的星罗帝国。
法斯诺行省位于两国交界处，而圣魂村旁的诺丁城更是距离星罗帝国只有不到二百里的路程而已。
唐三从村民的交谈中知道，在斗罗大陆中，没有自己那个世界的武功，但却有一种叫武魂的东西。据说，每个人都有属于自己的武魂，其中，极少一部份人的武魂可以进行修炼，形成了一个职业，叫做魂师。而泛大陆最高贵的职业就是魂师。像百年前传说中从圣魂村中走出的那位魂圣，就是一名魂师，魂圣是魂师到了一定级别的称号。
武魂分为两大类，一类是器武魂，一类是兽武魂。顾名思义，以器具为武魂者，就是器武魂，以动物为武魂者，就是兽武魂。相对来说，器武魂包含范围更大，大多数人也都是器武魂，而器武魂中无法修炼的武魂也要比兽武魂的比例更大。
唐三曾经见过村子里一个人的武魂是锄头，显然是一种无法修炼的武魂，但尽管如此，他在耕地的时候，依旧要比普通村民的速度快一些。
这也是唐三了解的全部了，因为每个人都会有自己的武魂，唐三也想知道，自己的武魂是什么。究竟是器武魂还是兽武魂，又是否能够修炼呢？
斗罗大陆上的人，武魂觉醒在六岁的时候，再过几天，唐三就要六岁了，不知道为什么，他隐约感觉到，自己的玄天功之所以无法突破，似乎就与这武魂有些关系。
对于成为魂师，唐三到不怎么感兴趣，但他却立志要成为一名唐门内门级别的暗器高手，又怎么少的了内力呢？
“唐昊，忙着呢？”正在唐三朝着自己那一万次锻造努力的时候，听到外面传来一个苍老的声音。
这会儿是下午，唐昊正在工作，打造着农具，闻言只是嗯了一声。
唐三有些好奇的从自己的房间走出来，只见来的是一名老人，看上去六十多岁的样子，身材瘦长，但精神矍铄，衣服干净整洁，头发也梳理的一丝不苟，和唐昊相比，简直就是两个极端。
这个人唐三认识，是圣魂村的村长老杰克。
“小三，来，让爷爷看看。”老杰克向唐三挥了挥手。

这位村长是个老好人，村里的人都很尊敬他，早几年，唐三家最困难的时候，他没少送吃的过来。
“杰克爷爷，您好。”唐三走到老杰克面前，恭敬的向他行礼。对于对自己好的人，唐三都会铭记于心。
唐昊冷淡的道：“有事么，村长。”老杰克其实比他大了还不到十岁，却硬是要比他高一辈，令唐昊一直有些不爽。
老杰克似乎已经习惯了唐昊这样的态度，“唐昊啊，小三也快六岁了吧。今年的觉醒仪式他也应该参加了。”
唐昊看了唐三一眼，淡然道：“那就参加吧。是哪天？”
老杰克道：“就在三天后，到时候我来接他好了。”他看着唐昊的样子，很明显是想说，要是指着你送他去，恐怕就耽误了。
唐昊点了下头，就不再理会这位村长了。
唐三却有些好奇的问道：“杰克爷爷，什么是觉醒仪式？”
老杰克正色道：“我们每个人都有属于自己的武魂，到了六岁左右就要进行觉醒仪式。有了武魂，会对我们某方面的能力增强。哪怕是最普通的武魂，也会有所帮助。万一你要是拥有一个出色的武魂，可以进行修炼的话，那么，你甚至有可能成为魂师。觉醒仪式一年才有一次，我可不能让你错过了。是诺丁城武魂分殿的执事大人亲自来帮助我们村里的孩子觉醒呢。那位执事大人可是以为大魂师级别的魂师。”
说道大魂师三个字的时候，杰克眼中明显流露出了羡慕之色。
唐三对于魂师的概念只是模棱两可的听说过一些，此时抓住机会自然不会轻易放过，追问道：“大魂师是什么意思？”
content_en:
Tang San didn't want to lose his father, and he didn't want anyone to know about his past, so he naturally wouldn't tell Tang Hao. This was because he was practicing the Tang Sect's Mysterious Jade Hand.
If you want to use concealed weapons well, the most basic requirement is the integration of eyesight, hand strength, and mental strength. As the saying goes, what the heart sees is what the eyes see, and what the eyes see is what the hands see. Therefore, the cultivation methods of the inner sect of the Tang Sect have extremely high requirements for eyesight and hand strength.
The Purple Demon Eyes can be practiced with the help of the brief moment when the purple energy comes from the east when the rising sun rises, which can greatly improve eyesight.
The mysterious jade hand can make the palm extremely tough and isolate any toxins.
These two abilities are compulsory courses for inner disciples of the Tang Sect. Although Tang San's mysterious jade hands were far from strong enough, he could still protect his palms from getting blisters.
"Work harder and we can finish it today." Tang San waved the hammer in his hand vigorously, but during this boring process, his heart was not at peace. His understanding of this world is still very preliminary. After all, this is just a small village.
This world is called Douluo Continent. There are two major empires on the continent, or it can be said to be two alliances. Because in the two empires, a large number of territories were divided into feudal lords, and there were countless nobles with armed forces.
One of these two empires was the Tiandou Empire where Tang San was located, and the other was the Xingluo Empire in the south.
Fasno Province is located at the junction of the two countries, and Notting City next to Holy Soul Village is less than 200 miles away from the Star Luo Empire.
Tang San knew from the villagers' conversations that in Douluo Continent, there was no martial arts like his own, but there was something called martial arts. It is said that everyone has their own martial soul, and among them, a very small number of people's martial souls can be cultivated, forming a profession called soul master. And the most noble profession in Pan-Continent is soul master. Like the legendary Soul Saint who walked out of the Holy Soul Village a hundred years ago, he was a soul master. Soul Saint is the title given to a soul master who has reached a certain level.
Martial spirits are divided into two categories, one is the weapon spirit and the other is the animal spirit. As the name suggests, those who use tools as their martial souls have weapon souls, and those who use animals as their martial souls have animal martial souls. Relatively speaking, weapon martial souls cover a wider range, and most people also have weapon martial souls, and the proportion of martial arts souls that cannot be cultivated among weapon martial souls is larger than that of beast martial souls.
Tang San once saw a person in the village whose martial spirit was a hoe. It was obviously a martial spirit that could not be cultivated, but despite this, he was still faster than ordinary villagers when plowing the land.
This is all Tang San knows, because everyone has their own martial spirit, and Tang San also wants to know what his own martial spirit is. Is it a weapon soul or a beast soul, and can it be cultivated?
For people on Douluo Continent, the martial soul awakens when they are six years old. In a few days, Tang San will be six years old. For some reason, he vaguely felt that the reason why his Xuantian Technique could not break through seemed to have something to do with this martial soul.
Tang San wasn't very interested in becoming a soul master, but he was determined to become a hidden weapon master at the Tang Sect's inner sect level, so why did he lack internal strength?
"Tang Hao, are you busy?" While Tang San was working hard towards his ten thousand forgings, he heard an old voice coming from outside.
It was afternoon now, and Tang Hao was working, building farm tools. He just hummed when he heard this.
Tang San walked out of his room with some curiosity. He saw an old man who looked like he was in his sixties. He was slender but energetic. His clothes were clean and tidy, and his hair was combed meticulously. Compared with Tang Hao, he was two extremes.
This person Tang San knew was Jack, the village elder of Holy Soul Village.
"Xiao San, come here, let grandpa take a look." Old Jack waved to Tang San.
This village chief is a good old man, and everyone in the village respects him. A few years ago, Tang SanWhen the family was in the most difficult situation, he always sent food over.
"Hello, Grandpa Jack." Tang San walked up to Old Jack and saluted him respectfully. Tang San would always remember those who were kind to him.
Tang Hao said coldly: "What's the matter, village chief?" Old Jack was actually less than ten years older than him, but he insisted on being a generation older than him, which made Tang Hao always feel unhappy.
Old Jack seemed to be used to Tang Hao's attitude, "Tang Hao, Xiao San is almost six years old. He should also participate in this year's awakening ceremony."
Tang Hao glanced at Tang San and said calmly: "Then let's participate. When is it?"
Old Jack said: "It's just three days later. I'll pick him up then." He looked at Tang Hao, and it was obvious that he wanted to say that if he pointed you at sending him there, I'm afraid it would be delayed.
Tang Hao nodded and ignored the village chief.
Tang San asked curiously: "Grandpa Jack, what is the awakening ceremony?"
Old Jack said sternly: "Each of us has our own martial spirit, and when we are about six years old, we must undergo an awakening ceremony. Having a martial spirit will enhance our abilities in certain aspects. Even the most ordinary martial spirit will be helpful. In case you have an outstanding martial spirit, you can If you practice, you may even become a soul master. The awakening ceremony only happens once a year, and I can't let you miss it. The deacon of the Notting City Martial Arts Branch is here to help the children in our village awaken. "
When he said the words "Great Soul Master", Jack's eyes clearly showed envy.
Tang San had only vaguely heard about the concept of soul master, so he would not let it go easily when he seized the opportunity, and asked: "What does great soul master mean?"
